title: Zuleika tells Gatchalian ‘here she is’ as Sara Duterte arrives at Senate

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “Here she is.” This was how Office of the Vice President (OVP) Chief of Staff and Undersecretary Zuleika Lopez introduced Vice President Sara Duterte to Senate President Win Gatchalian when the vice president arrived at the Senate on Thursday. “Hinanap niyo daw ako,” (You were looking for me) Duterte likewise greeted Gatchalian. READ: Gatchalian questions Duterte’s absence at OVP budget hearing Her arrival came as senators prepared to deliberate on the OVP’s proposed P785.2-million budget for 2027. It can be recalled that during the committee-level deliberations on the OVP’s budget last October, Gatchalian questioned Lopez regarding Duterte’s absence. […]...
